text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With three days left until his Make Debut,
Calstone Light O was going through final gallops.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!
choice_data_list: Alright, looking good! Keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *huff, puff, pant*...
choice_data_list: That's a new record again today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Initially, I didn't expect immediate results, but
improving her form led to considerable progress.
Her times continue to break records day after day.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I could have shaved off more time.
If only I hadn't wavered on the corner. How regrettable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She isn't satisfied, but for a pre-debut Umamusume, she is plenty fast.
Fast enough to even expect a blowout victory.
choice_data_list: With this, I shouldn't have to worry about my debut race.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes. I want to make my debut as soon as possible.
choice_data_list: That's one way to put it... By the way, did you prepare for the expedition?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Depending on the Umamusume, some have no experience
traveling away before their debut. In such cases,
it would be best to support how they spend their time.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Not yet.
choice_data_list: We're done for today, so go home and get packed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for that.
Packing will only take me three minutes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Three minutes... I firmly resolved to make sure
I check all my belongings tomorrow morning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing her personality,
she must have forgotten something...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then came the Make Debut.
Calstone Light O showed no signs of nervousness,
remaining her usual calm self.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"The time has finally come.
I will run the absolute fastest race I am currently capable of."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Running with everything I have, race by race.
So that I can reach the edge of that light.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'll keep beating my own top speed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O's desire to reach top speed remains unwavering.
Even so—
choice_data_list: Don't forget to go for the win, either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A race is a contest, not a time trial.
The results are dictated by your opponents and how the race unfolds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, clashing fiercely with strong rivals can draw out strength beyond one's limits. The top speed I aim for cannot be reached without competition.
choice_data_list: I'm going to run faster than anyone and win!
I'm going to run faster than anyone and win!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Keep my mind on the competition, you mean?
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'll try focusing on victory and defeat
during my mental training!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, I'll pull ahead right from the start!
Heh, they'll never catch up!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Holding the lead to the very end... Wait, what!?
They're closing the gap!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivid commentary spills from Calstone Light O's mouth.
It seems a razor-thin race is unfolding.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... What a stride!
There's no way I can match that leg length...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'm gonna lose!
HAAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Flightless birds are no match for me!
Ostriches, back off!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright!!
Trainer, I won against the ostrich!
choice_data_list: Why is your racing opponent an ostrich...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Even if you ask me why...
It's just my usual image training.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I was in an ostrich mood today.
That was a nail-biter of a match...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I was able to focus firmly on winning!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Would that really be okay...? Judging from the
look of things, her concentration has peaked.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off!
